posts.post_subject: Need photo of a hologram in exhibition
posts.content_md:
Hi folks. I have been talking to someone putting a show together and they want something to grab attention. There are people suggesting Pepper's ghost etc, but I think there is a chance of using conventional holograms, say 50X60". It will be some engine parts, so nothing artistic. Just a stunning hologram.

Now, the meeting is tomorrow morning, UK time, so I need to find an image today, which might capture their imagination, so that at least they consider holograms. All I need is a photo of a large hologram in an exhibition, perhaps with someone standing in front looking at it. It is a small meeting so we do not need publication rights, just something to grab them.

If you have any images with decent resolution (800X600 will do) please send me at

[kaveh@holographer.org](mailto:kaveh@holographer.org)

If you think you can produce such an image (there will be 4-5 of them) I will be happy to hear from you too and please send photos. But I repeat this is the first presentation to fend off the pseudo-holograms!!

Appreciate your help.
